uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When an ally is under the effect of one of Alcremie's shields or buffs, remove any hindrances that are applied or are currently affecting that ally. This ability will go on cooldown for 10s after removing a hindrance. This ability can also work on Alcremie as well. When Milcery evolves into Alcremie, gain a Sweet Gauge. When the Sweet Gauge is filled at 15 stacks, the cooldown of one charge of Recover and Decorate will be reset. These moves will also be empowered.
Attacks by throwing whip cream. Milcery and Alcremie do not have a boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Grant a designated ally Pokémon or yourself a shield for 3s, in addition to increasing the recipients Attack by 40 and Special Attack by 25 for 3s

Grant a designated ally Pokémon or yourself a shield for 4s. If the shield is granted to an ally Pokémon, Alcremie receives an extra shield of the same value. Basic and boosted attacks by the shielded Pokémon will deal additional damage and increase Alcremie's Sweet Gauge by 1 for 6s. The extra shield Alcremie receives when using Decorate on an ally does not apply additional damage to Alcremie's attacks. Alcremie's basic attacks will also increase the Sweet Gauge by 1. When empowered by a full Sweet Gauge, the attacks deal even more additional damage. The additional damage depends on the shielded Pokémon's level. Only one main Decorate shield can be active at a time.
Increases the strength of the shield.

Place a dollop of whipped cream at a designated location for up to 20s. When an ally Pokémon picks up the whipped cream, their HP is restored and their movement speed is increased by 15% for 2s. When whipped cream is consumed by ally Pokémon, the Sweet Gauge is also increased by 3. When the Sweet Gauge is full, the next dollop becomes sweeter, restoring more HP and increasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s instead and increases the Sweet Gauge by 5. Two dollops may be kept in reserve. An ally Snorlax will heal additional HP from the dollops.
The maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve is increased to 3.

Charm a target Pokémon with your cute voice, dealing damage to the first Pokémon hit. Pokémon hit by the charm have their Attack reduced by 30 and Special Attack reduced by 20 and movement speed reduced by 30% for 2s. Additionally, increases the sweet gauge by 2.

Release a conal ray of light in a designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, stunning them for 0.4s and increasing the Sweet Gauge by 4 for every opposing Pokémon hit. If an ally Pokémon has been affected by Decorate, the decorated Pokémon will also release a conal ray of light. Alcremie can move around while casting this move, but is slowed by 20%.
Increases the damage of this move.

Launch a sweet scent at a designated location, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area and lowering their movement speed by 30%, decaying by 10% every 0.5s. The outer ring of the scent remains for 3s, dealing damage, applying a 100% slow lasting 0.5s to oppposing Pokémon who touch the ring. Both the intial area and outer ring can hit at the same time. Increases the Sweet Gauge by 2 for every hit.
Increases the duration of the outer ring slow to 1.5s.

Create a giant cake and stand atop it becoming unstoppable and gaining a shield for 6s. Then throw whipped cream at allies. Allies who receive whipped cream are healed and have their maximum HP buffed for 8s. This move ends early if this move's shield is lost, Alcremie becomes bound, or if the move is manually cancelled. The shield is 60% of Alcremie's max HP
Buffs: 40% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield (Applied when the move ends) Buff duration: 6
